scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build --prefix client && npm run dist:portable --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build --prefix client && npm run pack --prefix desktop
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build --prefix client && node scripts/sync-mobile-assets.js
scripts.mobile:dev: npm run mobile:sync && concurrently -k "npm run dev --prefix client" "cd mobile && flutter run"
scripts.mobile:run: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && flutter run
scripts.mobile:build: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && flutter build apk --release && node ../scripts/package-mobile-release.js
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && flutter build apk --split-per-abi
scripts.mobile:bundle: npm run mobile:sync && cd mobile && flutter build appbundle
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix desktop && cd mobile && flutter pub get
